en: Sepia-toned vintage photograph of a small steam-powered workboat or tugboat on an industrial harbor or river. Smoke pours from a tall funnel marked with the letter 'R'. Two men stand on deck. In the background are long warehouse buildings, a tall grain-elevator- or factory-like structure, and an elevated conveyor crossing above the quay. The water in the foreground reflects the boat and buildings. There is no visible printed caption, only the photograph image, with a vertical crease down the center suggesting age or folding.
